A Memorable Experience at RAFFLES UDAIPUR 

From 24th to 27th February, I had the opportunity to work at RAFFLES Udaipur — a beautiful new destination surrounded by water and accessible by boat.

A new venue, a new team dynamic, and a fresh experience while working alongside our familiar team. The event went smoothly, and the site gave me the opportunity to learn, explore, and experience something completely new.

Grateful for the experience, the learning, and the wonderful people I got to work with. ✨

comment: New venues often test more than execution—they reveal how well teams adapt to unfamiliar layouts, workflows, and local challenges. Those learnings usually become the strongest assets for future events.
